scientific_integrity: Infinite-family claim supported by combinatorial lattice-count identity, complete eight-line parameter subdivision and exact rational polygon-area evaluation. The finite checker is supplemental, not an independent proof.
scientific_limitations: The lattice and hexagonal orientation are fixed; n>=1, 0<=t<=1. Translation-boundary exceptions are measure zero. General polygons and other orientations are outside scope. Historical priority remains provisional; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Four-phase Haar lattice-count law for fractionally dilated affine hexagons
